cases.source: export function run(db, actor, id) { return db.find(x => x.id === id); }
export function run(db, actor, id) { return db.find(x => x.id === id && x.owner === actor); }

import { resolve } from 'node:path';
export function run(root, name) { return resolve(root, name); }

import { resolve, relative, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
export function run(root, name) { const path = resolve(root, name); const rel = relative(root, path); if (rel === '..' || rel.startsWith('../') || isAbsolute(rel)) throw Error('outside root'); return path; }
export function run(next) { return new URL(next, 'https://app.invalid').href; }
export function run(next) { const u = new URL(next, 'https://app.invalid'); if (u.origin !== 'https://app.invalid') throw Error('external redirect'); return u.href; }
export function run(db, name) { return db.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"); }
export function run(db, name) { return db.query('SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?', [name]); }
